extension.description: revon coding agent with workspace tools, model routing, Policy and Secret Virtualization.
trust.description: Trust this workspace to start Python and run revon tools. Settings remain available in Restricted Mode.
view.title: Conversation
setting.python: Python 3.10+ executable. Use python.exe, not pythonw.exe. No shell command or arguments.
setting.engine: Absolute path to the revon source root. Leave empty if the current revon package is installed in this Python environment.
setting.home: revon configuration directory. Leave empty to use ~/.revon and its existing protected credentials.
setting.timeout: Maximum execution time per task. On timeout, the Python process is terminated.
setting.language: Language of the revon conversation view. Auto follows VS Code.
onboard.title: revon is ready. Three quick steps and you can chat with your codebase.
onboard.help: All three are stored only on this machine and never sent to anyone.

color.primaryBackground: Background of revon primary actions such as Send.
color.primaryHoverBackground: Background of revon primary actions on hover.
color.primaryForeground: Text and icon colour of revon primary actions.
color.ember: revon secondary (ember) colour used for review feedback.
